loginMode.title: Login Mode
loginMode.description: Login Mode for Microstrategy's REST API connection. You can authenticate with one of the following authentication modes: `Standard (1)`, `Anonymous (8)`. Default will be `Standard (1)`. If you're using demo account for Microstrategy, it will be needed to authenticate through loginMode `8`.
